conditions: Coordinated quiet window, 9 alternating before/after samples after warmup. Assertion state is recorded in each immutable compile command; experiments kept separate. Input generation, process startup and output excluded. Tree operation phase includes one all_prod checksum after every set. SAM build, first lazy count, repeated count/contains and LCS are separate. Destruction excluded. Process RSS includes generated inputs. Shared-host activity possible.
metadata_correction: Summary prose corrected to nine repetitions; repeats=9 and all raw samples were already accurate and unchanged.
